title: resource-deficit
description: The pair (De, Co) of predication cells where a resource settling falls below its theory-relative ideal in the knowledge order (deficient) or is knowledge-incomparable to it (contradicted); generated by comparing the settling cellwise against its theory-relative ideal.

ideal.description: the theory-relative ideal v^R_{T,infty} the resource settling is compared against

deficient.description: De = { c : v^R(c) <_k v^R_{T,infty}(c) }; cells where the theory's settled state has more knowledge than the resource expresses

contradicted.description: Co = { c : v^R(c) incomparable_k v^R_{T,infty}(c) }; cells where resource and theory assert incompatible truth-values

partition.description: Al, De, Ex, Co are pairwise disjoint and cover all predication cells; the deficit is the (De, Co) projection of this four-class partition
